derived.method: CalPERS shares ÷ shares outstanding, all classes (666,043 ÷ (263,233,141 Class A + 28,550,570 Class B))

inputs.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, cover page
inputs.quote: As of August 14, 2026, the number of shares of the registrant's Class A common stock outstanding was 263,233,141 and the number of shares of the registrant's Class B common stock outstanding was 28,550,570 .

inputs.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Note 10, share class rights
inputs.quote: The Class A and Class B common stock have the same dividend and liquidation rights.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: As of January 31, 2026, we had 47 holders of record of our Class A common stock and 8 holders of record of our Class B common stock.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026; Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS holds Class A; the denominator is Class A plus Class B from the 10-Q cover at August 14, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: listed Class A only; the 10-K also gives 8 holders of record of Class B.
